$comment: What scripts/live-run.mjs runs for this leaf. Setup starts an Ollama server (daemonised: setup lines are foreground, and the CI job's teardown stops it) and pulls the model, so Command 1's completion - the leaf's 'what did the provider actually serve' check - runs against the live endpoint. Commands 2-5 read the log fixtures declared here: honest, spec-authored records in the exact shape the leaf's logging section writes, with the fields, the space-after-colon JSON and the length-stopped day the commands exist to find. Command 6 proves the leak check passes on a clean log. KEY is a dummy: Ollama ignores it, the leaf's commands require one, and Command 6 needs its first twelve characters to grep for.

files.make-logs.sh: mkdir -p logs && printf '%s\n' '{"correlation_id": "abc-123", "rendered_prompt": "Summarise invoice INV-42 for the finance team.", "response": "INV-42 totals 1,240 EUR across three lines."}' '{"correlation_id": "def-456", "rendered_prompt": "List open tickets.", "response": "Two tickets are open."}' > logs/app.jsonl

setup.run: (ollama serve > ollama-server.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1
